steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: That crevice over there should be close enough...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Weiss, how long do you think it'll be before my brother comes back?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Based on what the Master said before the trip, about three or four more days.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Eh... That's still pretty far from now.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Huh? Is that him...?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No wait, is it my sister?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The Saintess went to the Vine-Bead Court months ago. With everything she must attend to, there's no way she'd be here. No need to get antsy; I'll get the door.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh, Auntie Tarja! What brings you here?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: That's one step closer!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: The cave's not really all that high up, so I should be there soon.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Tearstone?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It's a kind of light blue ore, only found in a cave halfway up Mount Karlan. Legend has it that it's the condensed tears of Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Almost there!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: So Uncle Tarja's condition got worse, the tearstone that was supposed to last over half a year was used up by autumn, and no one on either side of the mountain can lend him any more?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: How could this happen...?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: According to legend, tearstone can only be mined one palmful at a time, for that is the size of one of Kjeragandr's teardrops.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: If any more are extracted at once, then they lose their effectiveness.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: In fact, you were the one who retrieved the one Mister Tarja was using. That was two years ago though, so you might not remember it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh, right, I remember now!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Weiss, think you could bring Auntie Tarja with you and drive around to see if anyone else has any tearstone?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Milady, you...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'll keep looking around the house. I remember picking up a little one to use as a decoration, but can't remember where I put it.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Y-Yeah, I'm positive. As soon as I find it, I'll grind it down for Uncle Tarja and decoct it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: And if you do manage to find one, you don't need to come tell me. Just head straight to the Tarja household.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Please be careful, milady.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: It's... It's not like I'll be doing anything dangerous, just looking around the house! Anyway, get going already! Someone's life is on the line here!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'll get the car ready. Missus Tarja, come with me.
Ensia turns her head and takes a look at the ashen-gray sky.
For now, the clouds aren't too dense, and not even a single sign of wind can be seen through the window.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Weiss's intuition is as sharp as ever.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: If it weren't for Uncle Tarja's emergency situation, he definitely wouldn't have left me alone.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Seriously, he's way too much of a worrywart. The snow won't be coming down hard until later in the evening anyway, and the cave isn't too high up. Just a quick climb up the cliff.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Welp, up we go!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Now all that's left is to head in and mine some tearstone. Shouldn't take long!
Ensia closes her eyes and silently bows to the holy Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Success! Fits perfectly, right inside my palm.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Still, I may have been pulling a fast one on Weiss, but tearstones are so pretty. Maybe I really should grab a few more for decoration next time...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: That said, I can still see the marks I made on the walls here two years ago. Nothing's changed at all.
Ensia stands at the mouth of the cave and looks down the mountain. She can still see the smoke from the Tarja household.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Just wait for me. I'll get you your tearstone in no time flat!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Brrr, so cold!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: The wind's kicking up?!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Crap, that snowstorm's coming in a lot sooner than I thought.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Welp, can't get down the cliff anymore. Better take shelter in the cave and wait it out...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Wait, no. Uncle Tarja's still waiting for that tearstone, and who knows when the storm will stop?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'll have to descend from the other side then.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hmm... This route seems usable, but which way am I...?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: This tree looks familiar... Wait, haven't I been here already?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'll make a sign with my climbing rope. At least that way I won't be going in circles.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: This path is... going in the exact wrong direction.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Ugh, this snow couldn't have come at a worse time.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I think I've come a pretty long way...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: The cave is on the side of the mountain where it meets the lake, but I've been heading towards the lake this entire time...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I guess I'm already trespassing on Paleroche land then.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Stepping into another clan's territory without notice...
Even though her brother never went out of his way to discuss the other two clans with her, Ensia is no fool.
She knows that the Paleroche and Silverash clans have been at odds ever since Enciodes returned to Kjerag.
And before his latest trip, he specifically warned her not to have anything to do with the Paleroches unless absolutely necessary.
The situation in Kjerag was too delicate, and even a single careless whisper could trigger an avalanche.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Maybe I should turn back before they find me. Wait out the snow before heading back down...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No, I can't risk it. Doesn't look like it'll be stopping anytime soon.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: This is a matter of life and death here! Time is of the essence!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: At least the snow's thick enough that I didn't get hurt by the fall...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hmm, I can see the settlements at the foot of the mountain.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: And the lake too.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Feels like I've been trekking through the mountain's backside for forever. How is there still more trail...?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I can't even see the lake anymore...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I can tell I'm still descending, but this trail is way too long—
Suddenly a figure emerges through the wind and snow and into Ensia's field of view, like a miracle.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hello? Hello?!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Can you hear me? I'm over here! Over here!
The figure notices her immediately and walks straight towards her.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Thank Kjeragandr! Are you a hunter from the mountains? How far are we from the bottom?

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: If you follow this trail down, you'll be off the mountain in about an hour and a half.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: An hour and a half? Still that far?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: There wouldn't happen to be any shortcuts?

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: There are, but none that can be used in a snowstorm this fierce.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I have mountaineering equipment! See this big ole backpack? I've got an icepick, climbing ropes, rock nails, the whole shebang!

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: Hmm... It could be worth a try then.

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: If you head back a bit to where you just saw the lake, there's a steep little trail covered in snow.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Thank you! By the way, I didn't get your...
Before Ensia could finish her words, there was nothing in her field of view except the wind and snow. As if Kjeragandr had deliberately hidden her guide from her.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: She's gone?!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Well, whatever. Let's head back and give this a shot!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: It worked!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: That must've saved at least half an hour! Now to find a place where I can rent a burdenbeast or—

steps.name: Mountaineer
steps.text: Stop! Who goes there?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hello, I don't mean any harm! I'm...

steps.name: Mountaineer
steps.text: Huh? Aren't you the second daughter of the Silverash clan?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I can explain, I—

steps.name: Mountaineer
steps.text: Hmph, I'm just patrol the mountain. Save your explanation for the head of our clan!
The fragrance of the hot tea and sweets prepared by the servants still wafts from the table, but the two in the reception room do not sit, nor does a single drop or crumb pass their lips.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Tell me, what's going on here?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'm sorry! I didn't mean to trespass into your territory!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Everyone who gets caught says that.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I mean it though...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: So you're telling me you were taking a walk in your backyard, enjoying the snow, and just happened to end up near the lake?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No, I went to mine tearstone from a mountain cave, and it started snowing right as I was about to leave. Since I couldn't get down the cliff near my house, I headed the opposite direction, towards the lake.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Did you not see the dark clouds? You chose now of all times to mine your tearstone?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I’ve heard enough.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No, Mister Arctosz, let me explain—

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The second daughter of the Silverash clan has trespassed on Paleroche territory.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'll have your brother explain the situation once he returns. If his answer satisfies me, I'll let you go.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (He's going to wait for Enciodes?!)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (But Uncle Tarja is sick and can't wait any longer!)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (I need to get this medicine to him right away! Which means my only choice is to—)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (But now that it's come to this, I don't know what Mister Arctosz's demands will be, or if my brother will be humiliated...)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (Damn it, none of this has anything to do with the clans! Just because I'm a Silverash...)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (I'm sorry, Enciodes! If this causes any trouble, I'll make it right, I swear!)

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Judging by the look on your face, it seems you have something to say.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I sincerely apologize for trespassing into the lake area, and I'll accept however you choose to handle this matter.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But I went to mine tearstone in order to save someone's life...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Using another's life as an excuse is an awfully tasteless joke, Ensia Silverash.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'm not lying! Uncle Tarja, who lives in the mountains, is seriously ill and needs a tearstone to save his life. That's why I went up there!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'll accept whatever punishment you have for me, but I ask only that you send an express train to deliver the tearstone in my backpack to the Tarja household in the mountains. Please, I'm begging you!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If you claim to have mined tearstone, then show it to me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmm... this is certainly tearstone. But isn't it a bit too big?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: While I was up there, I made sure to test if it could fit in the palm of my hand.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: At least SOME of the Silverashes still remember a few of Kjeragandr's old teachings.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And you want me to deliver this to the Tarja household in the mountains, correct?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I suppose I can oblige.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Prepare the swiftest burdenbeast! I'll be heading to the mountains with Ensia Silverash!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (Thank goodness...)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: (—Wait, back up, with ME?!)

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Mister Arctosz, do you mean to say...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If the situation is as you described, then your trespass was truly unintentional.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Paleroche has no desire to raise a fuss over something like this.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I thought you would—

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Would what?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: N-nothing, nothing at all!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Thank goodness...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You have my deepest gratitude, Mister Arctosz! If we waited any longer, we might've been too late! Truly, I can't thank you enough!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You harvested the tearstone. It was your life to save. There's nothing to thank me for.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No, you deserve it! Would you like to stop by my house to rest for a bit? Uncle Matterhorn should be back shortly, and maybe I can let him—
Arctosz doesn't utter a word, simply gazing down at the excited Ensia like an immovable crag.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Sorry, I'm getting way ahead of myself.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Mister Arctosz...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Did you need anything else?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I still remember back before Enciodes returned. You were never close to me or my sister, but you didn't keep your distance from us like you do now.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If anyone's responsible for that, it would be your dear old brother, don't you think? While I am willing to believe that you harbor no ill will, I dare not ignore the possibility that you're a part of his plans.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Nor do I dare assume that I can beat him in on the battlefield of political intrigue.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Is my brother... really that odious a person to everyone else?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I can tolerate his scheming, but I cannot turn a blind eye to him trampling all over our traditions.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But not everything from outside is bad! Like, what if there were a better cure for Uncle Tarja's illness in some—

Ensia had only finished half her sentence when she sees the expression on Arctosz's face. She realizes then that a single gesture of aid from the patriarch of the Paleroche clan does not mean she has shortened the distance between them.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I can see that you and your brother are completely different kinds of people.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But both of you are true Silverashes.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doesn't that also make you a true Paleroche?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Ah, of course.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But you're still helping me.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Do you think I should have sentenced Tarja to death, or continued to detain you?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No, no, that's not what I meant!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I just... don't quite understand.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Then keep mulling it over. You still have a long life ahead of you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hold onto your own stuff. You were so excited to leave that you forgot your bag.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Is that you, Lady Ensia?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Weiss? It's me! Over here!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I was worried sick about you—

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Promise me you'll never do something that risky ever again!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But I'm perfectly fine, aren't I? The tearstone got delivered in time to boot. Maybe I ran into a snag or two along the way, but all's well that ends well.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Ugh... You're just as stubborn as the Master.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: By the way, you may not know this, but part of the reason he left the country this time was to develop tearstone as a resource.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: How so?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: He'd already asked Victoria's scientists to study it earlier, and it turns out the reason tearstones can cure illnesses is because they contain a special substance.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: And taking more or less from the cave at once does not change its efficacy.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: If we can make an industry out of mining and refining tearstone, not only would that boost Kjerag's economy, but our medicine could also benefit people in other countries.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You won't have to risk your life to harvest it anymore.
Upon hearing Weiss's words, Ensia couldn't help but think back to what she saw in the cave.
The crystal-clear tearstones embedded in the rock wall, almost pulling her into a trance. As if they really were Kjeragandr's tears.
Twice had she plucked them from that wall for Uncle Tarja's sake, and the traces of her theft were left clearly in those vacant holes.
They mingle with dozens of other such scars, each of indeterminate age.
Ensia suddenly becomes uneasy, as if there were a conflict between her brother's development plans and the pristine beauty of the cave.
In an attempt to dispel some of her unease, she tries to change the topic.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: By the way, what are we doing for dinner?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I heard Matterhorn mention that today's entrée will be braised beastmeat. I'm quite looking forward to it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I didn't even realize I was hungry until now, but my stomach started growling as soon as you said that!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Glad to hear you have a healthy appetite. Anyway, I trust you'll sort out your mountaineering bag as usual, while I go help out in the kitchen?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh Weiss, you joker...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: This afternoon, you—

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I was just about to thank you when you vanished without a trace before you could tell me your name!

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: Yet I arrived here all the same. Here, it's a letter for you.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: For me?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: From... my sister?!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I am the Saintess's head maid, but you can call me Kjarr.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Enya's head maid?!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Could it be that she knew I'd be climbing the mountain today, and sent you to guide me?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: As if. I was heading down to do some shopping and bumped into you by chance.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Then, you'd better not tell her that I climbed down the mountain in the snow!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Let's see here... I wonder how she's doing in the Vine-Bead Court...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Phew, sounds like it's going well.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: By the way, Kjarr, thanks for delivering this! I'll tell Uncle Matterhorn to make dinner for—

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Shh! I snuck in here.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Snuck in? But why?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Think about it. What would Weiss do if I graciously knocked on the front door, claiming to be the Saintess's head maid? He'd definitely report it to your brother.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: From Enciodes's perspective, people from the Vine-Bead Court slipping down to bring you mail when he's not around is more than enough reason to go on high alert.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Anyway, I'll wait for him to return before I formally introduce myself to everyone in the family.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Kjarr, this letter doesn't say anything about it, but Enya's still upset at him, right?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: To be honest, yes, I believe so.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Do you think she'll end up siding with Mister Arctosz in the end?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You've known the Saintess much longer than I have, and should know far more about her place in the Silverash clan than I do.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: She may be very upset at your brother, but you are still a sister to both of them.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Otherwise, you wouldn't be receiving this letter at all.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But she's now the Saintess of the Vine-Bead Court. Even if she wants to protect me, what can she do in our current situation...?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: It's like how I had a run-in with Mister Arctosz today, and discovered that he's not a bad person at all.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: No matter who they are, as long as they're involved in the struggle for power or profit, they'll always—

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: So that's what you're worried about.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Come. Let's cheer you up a bit first.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The Saintess's cheerful and optimistic little sister shouldn't be acting so gloomy.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The Saintess is not someone who will allow herself to be led around by emotions. She knows better than anyone how much responsibility sits on her shoulders.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But the actions she ends up taking depend not only on your brother, but also on you.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You are not his tool. You have your own path to walk. Choose it, and you will definitely have an influence on them both.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I can't promise anything, but it's possible that the path you take will eventually form the bridge between them.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I see... I'm starting to get what you mean.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Then I'll be heading back. It's hard keeping away from Weiss's prying eyes.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: So soon? I haven't even had a chance to properly thank you.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: We'll being seeing each other a lot more in the future.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Bye for now, Ensia.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: See you later, Kjarr!
Ensia watches the door close in front of her and sighs softly, before painstakingly folding the opened letter back up and stowing it in her pocket.
She then turns around and begins to organize her backpack.
Halfway through, she feels something strange inside her bag.
She digs around and places what she finds in front of her.
Two pieces of candy.
One is from the Paleroche clan's reception room.
She racks her brain hard to figure out where the other piece came from. Only then does she recall eating it once as a child. It was found only at the Vine-Bead Court.
